label: High-Distress Heavy-Screen-Time Graduate Women
summary: This profile captures highly educated women who spend more than five hours daily on screens and report elevated levels of loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety. Their UCLA-8 loneliness score (mean 1.72), PHQ-9 depression score (mean 1.76), and GAD-7 anxiety score (mean 2.18) all sit in the higher range, indicating a consistent pattern of psychological distress across all three dimensions. With 176 respondents in this cluster, the pattern is well-represented in the data.
